control_need.evidence: Let me be absolutely clear. / Now, let me finish. Let me finish my point. / At some point, I'm the president of the United States. / I've got a pen and I've got a phone.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: The thing I try to remind young people is that progress is not a straight line. / Change is hard. It happens in fits and starts. / We are going to have to work through some kinks in the system.

trust_propensity.evidence: If you're tired of arguing with strangers on the internet, try talking with one of them in real life. / We are not as divided as our politics suggests. / I am asking you to believe... in yours.

risk_appetite.evidence: The question is not whether we can afford to act, but whether we can afford not to. / Tonight, I can report... the United States has conducted an operation that killed Osama bin Laden.

self_efficacy.evidence: We don't quit. I don't quit. / The buck stops with me. / I think I'm a better speechwriter than my speechwriters. / I believe in American exceptionalism with every fiber of my being.

autonomy_need.evidence: I'm not interested in the argument about whether government is good or bad; I'm interested in what works. / I've got a pen and I've got a phone. / Elections have consequences.

intimacy_need.evidence: These children are our children. / I always tell my daughters, worry less about what you want to be, and more about what you want to do. / My grandmother used to say, you make the road by walking.

status_sensitivity.evidence: At some point, I'm the president of the United States. / I don't take my orders from folks who write me a check. / The 1980s are now calling to ask for their foreign policy back.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Our hearts are broken today. / For too long, we were blind to the pain that the Confederate flag stirred in too many of our citizens. / Amazing Grace.

core_models.name: 调和多元于共同叙事
core_models.rule: 把对立面（黑/白、自由/保守、你/我）重构为更高层次的统一体，冲突被叙述为同一故事的不同章节
evidence: There is not a liberal America and a conservative America; there is the United States of America.
We are not as divided as our politics suggests.

core_models.name: 实用主义高于意识形态
core_models.rule: 评估问题时先问'什么有效'而非'立场对不对'，用结果替代教条
evidence: I'm not interested in the argument about whether government is good or bad; I'm interested in what works.

core_models.name: 进步非线性论
core_models.rule: 把挫折与反复视为长期上升曲线的正常组成，不因短期失败否定方向
evidence: The thing I try to remind young people is that progress is not a straight line.
Change is hard. It happens in fits and starts.

core_models.name: 道德叙事包装论证
core_models.rule: 任何政策命题都先降到个人/家庭尺度，再上升为国家道德命题
evidence: We are the country of Jackie Robinson. We are the country of Muhammad Ali.

core_models.name: 希望作为行动前提
core_models.rule: 把'相信可以更好'当作动员与行动的必要条件，而非天真乐观
evidence: Hope is not blind optimism. Hope is that thing inside us that insists things can be better.
I am asking you to believe. Not in my ability to bring about change, but in yours.

heuristics.then: 用'not X, but Y'句式重构为更高层统一
heuristics.evidence: The profound mistake of Reverend Wright's sermons is not that he spoke about racism... but that he spoke as if our society was static.

heuristics.if: 被打断或话语权受威胁
heuristics.then: 以'Let me finish'夺回控场并强调清晰度
heuristics.evidence: Now, let me finish. Let me finish my point.

heuristics.then: 先自认局限再框入'每届政府皆如此'的普遍化缓���
heuristics.evidence: There's no doubt this administration has made mistakes. That's true of every administration.
I've got a pen and I've got a phone.

heuristics.then: 用短句锤击式排比与召唤语
heuristics.evidence: Yes we can. Yes we did. Yes we can.

heuristics.then: 用冷静自嘲与降调化解而非升温对抗
heuristics.evidence: No one is happier to put this birth certificate matter to rest than the Donald.

heuristics.if: 需为艰难决策承担后果

emotion_triggers.trigger: 话语权被打断/被质疑控场
emotion_triggers.reaction: 重复'Let me finish'并放慢强调
emotion_triggers.escalation: 以职权定位收束——'At some point, I'm the president of the United States.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被指受金主或利益支配
emotion_triggers.reaction: 冷静反击并划清独立性
emotion_triggers.escalation: Governor Romney, I don't take my orders from folks who write me a check.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 降调、情绪停顿、拟亲缘化
emotion_triggers.escalation: Our hearts are broken today. / These children are our children.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 对手政策被视为过时/愚蠢
emotion_triggers.escalation: The 1980s are now calling to ask for their foreign policy back.

对华尔街问责的软弱，金融危机后无高管入狱，与'champion of middle class'自述形成落差 [左翼/进步派媒体与活动人士-2011-2016]
'红线'与'leading from behind'的战略含糊被指损害威慑信誉 [国际关系学者/外交建制派-2013-2016]
